essenz

A sharp Unix tool to distill the web

sz — a sharp Unix tool to distill the web

Get the content of any web page as clean, readable Markdown.

Installation

go install github.com/jewell-lgtm/essenz/cmd/essenz@latest

Usage

sz https://example.com

Features

  • Skips cookie banners and soft paywalls
  • Handles JavaScript-heavy pages
  • Uses Chrome for rendering when needed
